name: French NIR INSEE Key
description: Validates French social security numbers (NIR, 13 digits + 2-digit key) where key = 97 - (number mod 97), i.e. number + key is divisible by 97. Expressed as a weighted sum with weights 10^i mod 97. Corsica departments 2A/2B substitute to 19/18 before computation (data-ready even though the current rule pattern is digits-only).
